name: Attachment
description: Suppressors, optics, muzzle devices, grips, and other weapon attachments
postCreateNotes: Set InventoryItemComponent > WeaponAttachmentAttributes > AttachmentType (AttachmentMuzzle, AttachmentSuppressor, AttachmentOptics..., must match the weapon's AttachmentSlotComponent)
Set attachment weight and handling impact if applicable
Test compatibility with at least one base weapon

variants.name: suppressor
postCreateNotes: AttachmentType is AttachmentSuppressor (inherited from Suppressor_Base via SCR_WeaponAttachmentSuppressorAttributes)

variants.name: optic
postCreateNotes: Set AttachmentType to the rail it mounts on (e.g. AttachmentOpticsRIS1913, AttachmentOpticsDovetailAK)
Configure optical magnification (1x for reflex, 4x+ for scope)
Set reticle texture and zero distance
Configure eye relief and field of view

variants.name: muzzle_device
postCreateNotes: Set flash hider effectiveness if applicable
